name: Stones of Sunlight
effect: One of three items needed to create the Rainbow Drop

name: Staff of Rain
effect: One of three items needed to create the Rainbow Drop
found_description: Give the Silver Harp to the man in a cave west of Kol

name: Silver Harp
effect: Summons monsters when used; exchange it for the Staff of Rain
found_description: Garin's Grave (northeast corner of Garinham dungeon)
note: Summons one of 6 monsters with near-equal odds (~16.4-16.8% each)

name: Erdrick's Token
effect: Proves you are Erdrick's descendant; needed for the Rainbow Drop
found_description: 70 steps south and 40 steps east of Tantegel Castle (use Gwaelin's Love to locate)

name: Fairy Flute
effect: Puts the Golem boss to sleep; required to defeat the Golem
found_description: Four steps south of the bath in Kol

name: Erdrick's Tablet
effect: Words of advice from Erdrick (lore item)
found_description: Erdrick's Cave, northwest of Tantegel Castle

name: Gwaelin's Love
effect: Gwaelin tells you EXP needed to level up and your distance from Tantegel Castle
found_description: Obtained by rescuing Princess Gwaelin from the Green Dragon in the Swamp Cave south of Kol

name: Rainbow Drop
effect: Creates the Rainbow Bridge allowing access to Charlock Castle
found_description: Bring the Stones of Sunlight, Staff of Rain, and Erdrick's Token to a man in a cave south of Rimuldar

name: Ball of Light
effect: Destroys all the monsters in Alefgard; ending of the game
